pages.description: An anime-style Princess Bubblegum stands in a royal ball gown with puffed sleeves, a collared bodice, and a tall rounded crown resting on her sweeping hair. With eyes gently shut and hands folded in front, this clean character line art offers smooth, distinct sections ideal for fine-liners or colored pencils.
